company.name: R.C. Andreae AG
company.distributes: Branded confectionery (gummies to chocolate), spreads, tea and coffee; exclusive general importer for Trolli in Switzerland.
company.channels_supplied: Large retailers, organised retail trade and about 3,000 food trade customers including kiosks, petrol stations and gastro businesses.
what_they_do_well: Exclusive Swiss general importer for Trolli, supplying large retailers and around 3,000 trade customers including kiosks and petrol stations.
company.fit_rationale: Describes itself as the leading Swiss company for exclusive confectionery distribution, so Diablo chocolate, sweets and biscuits slot into an existing sweets portfolio. Its reach into kiosks, forecourts and the organised trade gives national coverage including Zurich. No sugar free range was verified, leaving room for Diablo.

contacts.job_title: Teamleitung Administration, Personal, Marketing, Verantwortliche als Administrator IT-Systems
